meta.name: bamboohr-automation
meta.description: Automate BambooHR tasks via Rube MCP (Composio): employees, time-off, benefits, dependents, employee updates. Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动处理员工信息、请假、福利等人事任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果日常需要频繁操作BambooHR处理人事流程
copy.tagline_en: Automate employee info, time-off, benefits, and HR updates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently handle BambooHR tasks like employee updates and time-off

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询员工目录、查看和申请休假、更新员工信息、管理家属和福利，并追踪员工数据变更。
howto.when: 当用户询问员工信息、休假余额、请假申请，或要求更新员工资料、查看家属/福利时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下销售部所有员工的名单。
say.note: Claude 会调用获取全部员工工具并返回列表。

say.text: 我想申请下周一至周三的年假。
say.note: Claude 会先查询休假类型和余额，然后提交申请。

say.text: 更新张三的职位为高级工程师。
say.note: Claude 会先获取当前信息，再更新指定字段。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query employee directories, view and request time off, update employee information, manage dependents and benefits, and track employee data changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask about employee info, time-off balances, leave requests, or request to update employee data, view dependents/benefits.

say_en.text: List all employees in the Sales department.
say_en.note: Claude will call the get-all-employees tool and return the list.

say_en.text: Request annual leave from next Monday to Wednesday.
say_en.note: Claude will first query leave types and balances, then submit the request.

say_en.text: Update John's job title to Senior Engineer.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch current data and update the specified field.
